title: Ascalon Vanguard
wikitext:
The [[Ascalon Vanguard]] is the elite force under the command of [[Prince Rurik]]. They are completely independent of the financing and influence of the [[King Adelbern|king]], and are small but very powerful and strong.  As of late, the Ascalon Vanguard have turned on the offensive, instead of the defensive style of the [[Ascalon Army]].

The player, upon choosing a [[secondary profession]] and entering the [[Ascalon Academy]], becomes part of this fighting force. Additionally,
any player that achieves level 10 in pre-searing may assist the Ascalon Vanguard by undertaking quests given by [[Lieutenant Langmar]].

{{spoiler| ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]''}}
Many of the Vanguard members followed Rurik through the [[Shiverpeak Mountains]] with other [[Ascalon]]ians, though not all of them did. The [[Ebon Vanguard]], an off-shoot of the Ascalon Vanguard, remained behind [[Charr]] lines under [[Captain Langmar]]'s command. After the prince's demise, [[Captain Greywind]] continued to lead the refugees into [[Kryta]] and protected the [[Ascalon Settlement]] during the [[War in Kryta|civil war]].
